direction.concept: From among the audience, a film becomes a conversation. Close foreground listeners frame a central invitation as one adult passes a microphone toward another.
direction.substantive_non_glyph_visual: Two adult shoulder-and-profile crops enter from opposite lower edges; a hand and microphone establish conversation on the right. A smaller distant film screen is visible in the upper-left opening beneath a bridge beam. These people belong to one shared outdoor scene.
direction.expression_system: High-contrast image cuts preserve natural human proportions and readable gestures, with a controlled broad light field between them. Use close cropping and scale differences between foreground listeners and the distant screen, rather than a celebrity portrait.
direction.copy_visual_relationship: First gaze: the large inward-facing profiles and microphone exchange. Next: the central title and immediately adjacent schedule. The bodies are physical parentheses around a flat central text corridor; type touches their silhouette boundaries only through intentional whitespace.
direction.whole_visual_layout: Foreground bodies occupy the outer roughly 26% on each side and bleed through the bottom crop. Keep a central 42–44% corridor uniformly light and open from top to bottom. Distant screen remains entirely in the left image territory; the right gesture remains outside the corridor. Stack identity/activity, schedule/place, then practical guidance down the center.
direction.typography_plan: Korean title 32–36 px at width 720, English 18 px, descriptor 17–18 px. Time 26–29 px and date 20–22 px. Practical entries at least 17 px, with a slightly heavier weight. Left-align within the corridor; keep the supplied long descriptor to two lines and allow useful word-boundary wraps. Keep the Korean title on one line within the central approximately310px corridor; do not inherit a two-line stack from another role.
direction.color_material_emotion: Black and warm off-white image masses with a concentrated burgundy background create an intimate, grown-up cultural invitation. Controlled tonal cuts describe faces, clothing and contact; the bright information corridor remains plain and easy to read.
direction.distinction: Even without color/material labels, M4 has large edge-cropped foreground bodies framing text in the middle; M1 has an expansive distant audience on the left with text in a right-hand architectural opening. The near human exchange leads M4; the whole venue leads M1.

reference_observations.observed_principle: The first viewed cache uses a dramatically diagonal cropped leg and shoe, strongly separated flat color fields, a small side information column and an angled large title. The bodily gesture and crop establish the theatrical action before detail.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Use adult shoulder/profile and microphone crops to make conversation a visible action, while redesigning the type into a horizontal, high-contrast central corridor suited to the Korean copy and width720.

reference_observations.observed_principle: The second viewed cache fills most of a dark field with dense red directional scribbles that partly construct huge letterforms; comparatively small credit information remains near an edge. Density and movement carry the emotion.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Let the image margins carry expressive density and movement, while the supplied event and attendance copy receive an uninterrupted calm center. Preserve every supplied word as ordinary readable type.

direction.positive_construction: Set the adult profiles and microphone exchange at convincing close distance, retain a visible distant screen to establish cinema, then reserve and typeset the central corridor as three complete information groups.

copy_groups.position_relationship: Central corridor x28–71%, y5–39%; Korean title, English and descriptor form one ascending-to-descending hierarchy.
Same corridor y43–65%; date and larger time lead to venue, using the same left edge.
Same corridor y71–96%; four readable entries, clear of the foreground shoulder crops.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Outdoor short-film screening and conversation must be recognizable, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
